description: Towards a peer known Ed4 a segment that is not the last of its C_PDU is cut short so its D_PDU ends at the modem block boundary it would otherwise cross.
note: As dts-arq/data-ack-roundtrip with 40-byte blocks and dts.max_segment_size 30. Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ; its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (a 44-byte U_PDU, TTL 0) to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 makes the CAS call. The request goes at 75000 (25 bytes, peer of unknown edition, zero filled); at 91000 the Ed4 accept records the peer Ed4 (B-0228, B-0408) and makes the link, and the U_PDU goes down as a 50-byte ARQ C_PDU (C_PCI and DATA S_PDU header, 6 bytes, then the U_PDU). At 108000 it is placed. At the maximum segment size its first segment would be 30 bytes, a 49-byte DATA-ONLY from byte 0 to 48, across the boundary at byte 40, and it is not the last segment (20 bytes would remain). Towards a peer known Ed4 the segment is cut to 21 bytes so the D_PDU ends at the boundary (C-0553, C-0871, C-0872, C-1155): FSN 0, C_PDU START, TX WIN LWE (C-0176, C-0186), 40 bytes, block 0 of 3, EOT 30. The rest, 29 bytes, is the last segment and goes whole (C-0508 only limits short segments towards Ed3 peers, C-0554; C-1155 never shortens a last segment): FSN 1, C_PDU END, TX WIN UWE (C-0177, C-0185, C-1122), 48 bytes from byte 40, block 1, EOT 20. Both carry DELIVER IN ORDER as the SIS asked. 88 bytes need 3 blocks, the same as the 49 + 39 bytes unaligned would; the 32 spare bytes take two PADDING D_PDUs (EOT 10, C-0367, C-1154) and 10 bytes of zero fill. The transmission lasts 15150 ms and ends at 123150, when dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts. At 131000 the peer's ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 2 acknowledges both: dts.ack_wait stops, the C_PDU is confirmed and dts.ttd is cancelled. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 40 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500) (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its Ack Data in the header form and 19 bytes plus its Ack Data and CRC-32 in the long form, a PADDING D_PDU 11 bytes. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080).
